contracts.invariant: Every selected path is validated before any mutation; raw identities never become shell/display text. Captured canonical executable fingerprints and the working-directory-or-Git-directory inspection rule bind bare and ordinary repository operations. Rewritten targets require both requested link styles and exact endpoints.
contracts.rootCause: Partial validation and pathspec metacharacters can mutate the wrong files or leave a partially applied selection. Validating a locate folder only before queueing allows a replacement folder or reused administrative name to inherit mutation authority. Backlink names cannot prove a recreated folder belongs to the repository; treating regular strays as registrations blocks safe recovery, and validating only one moved destination can leave sibling links broken.

Actual raw-byte files are addressed; invalid selection causes no mutation.
No chunk launches after an unsafe capability/selection combination.

Replace the queued folder with another repository's worktree; compare exact .git, backlink, HEAD and index bytes, both repositories' refs, and the foreign checkout HEAD after refusal and subsequent queue release.

Captured original-folder ownership permits repairable missing or malformed links and rejects foreign targets, ambiguous registrations and malformed administrative backlinks.

A captured target rejects changed .git bytes, administrative backlinks or common links, replacement checkout or registration identities, and unreadable evidence while unchanged ownership remains valid.
A valid managed .git symlink remains browsable while automatic repair refuses to replace its object and preserves the exact symlink destination.

A readable stale .git symlink is not advertised as automatically repairable; refusal preserves the symlink object and destination, target identity and bytes, administrative links, HEAD, index and checkout content.

A moved checkout with a readable stale .git symlink retains its exact move identity and refuses automatic replacement while preserving the symlink, target bytes, registration metadata and tracked content.

With unchanged saved .git bytes, a previously missing target becomes a real foreign registration while Locate or repository-wide repair waits; re-resolution refuses mutation, preserving both repositories' links, administrative metadata, HEAD, index, content and refs, then releases the queue.

A captured stale .git target becomes an existing foreign directory without changing saved link bytes; validation and fresh capture reject it while the selected checkout identity and exact administrative fingerprint remain unchanged.

A selected .git link keeps its exact bytes while its Git-directory alias is retargeted; validation and fresh capture refuse while the raw link, administrative fingerprint and new alias destination remain unchanged.

An administrative backlink keeps its exact bytes while its path alias is retargeted to a different checkout; validation and fresh capture reject it, fresh fingerprint evidence changes and no longer matches the registered checkout path, and the backlink bytes and new alias destination remain unchanged.

An administrative common link keeps its exact bytes while its path alias is retargeted to a foreign common directory; validation and fresh capture refuse, fresh fingerprint evidence changes and no longer matches the registration ownership, and the common-link bytes and new alias destination remain unchanged.

Administrative fingerprints freeze the resolved endpoint of a backlink independently of its raw bytes; retargeting the checkout's managed .git symlink changes fresh evidence while captured and fresh fingerprints still attribute the same checkout path and registration identity.

Retarget a moved checkout directory alias while global repair waits; Git repairs the captured canonical checkout rather than the alias's new foreign target, preserving foreign links, metadata, HEAD, index, content and refs while the owned checkout becomes the published registration with its exact administrative backlink.

Capture owned and missing Git-directory targets through alias/.. paths, then retarget the alias without changing .git bytes; queued validation must reparse the saved bytes and reject the changed target resolution rather than trusting the normalized target captured earlier.
Every missing, empty, malformed or unresolved original gitfile remains inspectable but cannot authorize generic repair; filesystem contents and backlinks stay unchanged.
A recreated unrelated directory at the registration path remains unchanged and cannot be claimed through its historical backlink.
Regular administrative strays are captured without poisoning registration attribution or changing metadata.
One real Locate repair establishes reciprocal links for both captured moved destinations while preserving checkout HEADs, indexes, refs and contents.
A real bare repository captures a valid current inspection location and read-only prune preview without changing linked ownership evidence.
Count independent filesystem probes at multiple inventory sizes; each phase enumerates once and work grows per entry.
Rewrite a real Gitfile with equivalent endpoint/style and unchanged identity; raw evidence must differ while administrative and history-free projections remain equal.

For missing, empty, malformed and unresolved original links, reject generic repair, expose reclaim targets, and reconstruct only after consuming the explicit preview; preserve HEAD, refs, index and checkout contents.
Reject discarded, replayed and cross-service repair previews without launching Git; a fresh legitimate preview remains usable.
Replace an executable atomically or in place, or retarget its configured alias; old consent rejects and a fresh capability check enables a new request.
Measure alternating repeated/indexed capture pairs at 8, 32 and 128 registrations in Release, retaining complete filesystem proof and reporting genuine samples without a new timing floor.
Substitute a real foreign Gitfile after immutable capture but before FIFO admission; refuse repair and preserve both repositories while subsequent work progresses.

Real Locate with and without a healthy sibling preserves relative links despite absolute repository configuration; exact captured argv includes relative style, and an independently forced wrong-style write fails postconditions while refs, indexes and contents stay unchanged.
A known different checkout stays rejected with choose-another-folder guidance and unchanged administrative and checkout evidence.
A stale snapshot or malformed backlink stays rejected with refresh guidance and unchanged evidence.
A lone located relative checkout supplies the preferred style from captured bytes; replacing or removing its live Gitfile does not change that captured style and still invalidates authorization.
Captured all-relative, absolute, mixed, malformed, missing and empty scopes preserve the established global style policy without filesystem rereads.

Hold initial preparation behind an earlier no-op writer, add a real unrelated sibling before capture, then require the selected real repair and following writer to succeed in FIFO order while complete admitted metadata, refs, links and payload remain unchanged except the following lock.

Hold initial preparation behind an earlier no-op writer, remove a real unrelated sibling before capture, and require the selected real repair to use the admitted scope, preserve its independent Git state and release FIFO.
Hold initial discovery before any ownership seeds are accepted; reject repair with actionable Refresh guidance and no repair command, preserve Git state and allow the following real writer.

Replace the real administrative directory with a byte-equivalent new object, await accepted discovery despite equal visible records and zero snapshot publication, then require one fresh real repair using the new identity and unchanged Git state.

Capture a queued request before replacing its administrative object, accept an equal discovery into the cache, then reject the old request without repair while a new request uses the refreshed seeds successfully; preserve exact metadata, links, refs and payload.

Execute the held approved repair command once with real Git, change only the same regular stray object to a different byte length, and require successful post-write reconciliation, exact reciprocal links and HEAD/index/refs/payload preservation before FIFO progresses.

Accept both unchanged healthy mixed-style orientations only when the gitfile matches the requested style; reject equivalent-endpoint raw rewrites and incorrect repaired styles, preserving identity and endpoint checks.
Fault injected reads prove postconditions never open HEAD or locked, while preparation and consent still inspect their evidence.

Run real absolute/relative Locate and Reclaim, verify unchanged mixed or correctly normalized sibling links and directed endpoints, exact one repair command, rewritten target style and unchanged refs/content.
A target omitted from preparation cannot gain admission authority; explicitly recorded provisional absence retains the existing same-object recovery path.
The Swift Locate path repairs directed endpoints once, refuses changed final evidence without writing, preserves payloads and releases the shared writer.

contracts.invariant: Only the current mutation generation and comparison identity may publish a refresh or authorize a hunk; whole-file discards must revalidate the selected discardable files. List transactions publish one complete ordered selection of raw bytes and staging sides. Unchanged selection preserves capture; genuine selection changes and the exact caller raw-path set control discard authority. Background worktree discovery restores sidebar selection without replacing content mounted by an inspector or presenter. Prune authority is bound to the approved preview's administrative registrations and revalidated at writer admission; changed candidates require an updated preview and a new confirmation. Sidebar row restoration refreshes controls and preserves local-branch reference actions without changing mounted content or the browsed revision. Worktree callbacks and deferred confirmations retain their originating window, repository, service and presentation generation; closing or replacing an owner revokes authority even when the same objects are restored. Expected cancellation is silent while genuine current-owner failures remain observable. Repair and prune consent ignore HEAD-only changes but remain sensitive to exact links, lock and availability metadata, administrative identities, executable context and raw Git reports. Explicit History adopts the selected canonical checkout's newest captured revision; passive synchronization preserves its authoritative revision object and mounted content. Lifecycle menu actions use the clicked checkout even when several checkouts share a branch. Owner revocation cancels pending consent and publication while already-admitted checked writes drain through captured-context reconciliation. Operation-owned reconciliation retires earlier ordinary discoveries before they can republish stale records. Pure context checks do not restart capability probes; rejected queued requests coalesce a capability reprobe after admission release and never replay the write. Ownership evidence failures retain valid records and their original cause; stale ownership requires fresh discovery and a new request. Retired discoveries skip ownership scanning. Reclaim consent keeps both Return and Escape bound to cancellation. Fixture drainage delivers clients sequentially and drains the writer again after pane producers finish; revoked discard eligibility cannot reuse prior approval. Hiding, minimizing, or changing foreground windows does not revoke presentation authority: queued errors and repair/prune consent wait until the user returns to the original visible active key window without activating or restoring it. Close, repository or window replacement revokes authority. Deferred consent receives fresh single-use evidence after a genuine wait and is revalidated at confirmation; immediately available consent does not incur another inventory. Earlier invalidations are satisfied by owned reconciliation, while concurrent events and failed reconciliation retain one bounded recovery. Retained stale snapshots expose an accessible warning and Refresh action independently of row equality. Worktree removal rereads current inventory at FIFO admission and compares it with the original approved row; missing initial inventory also requires an owned read before any ordinary mutation. Changed or missing removal evidence rejects the request without adopting refreshed consent. Removal approval additionally binds HEAD OID, exact symbolic reference and detached state. Every owned preflight retires ordinary generations even when it rejects or fails. Inventory rows, flags and status publish coherently; status-only updates retain sidebar object identities. Style selection only prepares a plan; every repair write follows explicit approval of its fresh complete target list. A consumed-preview refresh failure remains terminal through repeated presentation waits.
contracts.rootCause: A stale callback or cached action can replace a newer selection or apply obsolete content. A prune confirmation detached from current registration identity can forget worktrees the user did not approve. Restoring a row without its selection notification leaves controls stale; treating worktree rows only as lifecycle actions loses retained reference actions. Rebuilding an action from current owners or checking visibility alone lets old callbacks and deferred clicks regain authority after replacement or reopening. Comparing history state as ownership revokes harmless consent; a first-branch lookup redirects duplicate-row actions, and passive checked-out-branch following can override another checkout's selected history. Removal discards history and therefore cannot use history-insensitive repair ownership consent. Old ordinary reads can otherwise overwrite a newer preflight. Retrying a consumed preview replaces the original failure with a token error.

tests.oracle: Index reconciliation finishes between stage and unstage, with tracked and Unicode paths preserving mutation order.
The next intended selection remains observable after staging.
A later user selection survives the delayed operation callback.
A real index publication makes the old action refuse mutation.

Missing, extra, differently scoped raw paths launch no mutation; equivalent reordered sets use frozen ordered bytes.
A real image lookup from an earlier render refuses bytes after refresh or deselection; an unchanged selection update preserves its read.

Calling the legacy destructive prune entry point without a captured preview refuses the operation and preserves the actual administrative registration.
Make another worktree prunable after preview; refusal preserves both real administrative directories and allows the following queued writer to complete.

A changed candidate set replaces the real confirmation sheet before any registration changes; cancellation preserves both backlinks and checkout HEADs, and a fresh approved preview then deletes its registrations while preserving the moved folder and main HEAD.
The native inspector stays visible at cold launch; explicit confirmation fetches only the approved ref and switches to the named branch at the approved OID.

Exact administrative fingerprints change for HEAD, lock, common-link and backlink bytes or replaced registrations, retain identity across index/log changes, and require a one-to-one match with registered paths.

Administrative fingerprints freeze the resolved endpoint of a backlink independently of its raw bytes; retargeting the checkout's managed .git symlink changes fresh evidence while captured and fresh fingerprints still attribute the same checkout path and registration identity.

Upstream configuration changes absent to present to absent at both rebuild boundaries update actual controls while canonical selection, mounted alternate content, the revision object, porcelain, refs and both HEADs stay unchanged.
Hold the shared writer, externally unlock, and require the later real Git error in the live origin plus exact ownership/content preservation and following-writer reconciliation.
Cancel the queued origin while its window remains visible; no mutation or error presentation occurs and the following real writer finishes.
Closing and reopening the retained window cannot revive the queued callback; captured links and content survive and the following writer finishes.
A real held Git rejection across repository or window A-to-B-to-A replacement never presents in the restored owner and releases the shared writer.
An accepted forced-removal click dispatched after owner replacement cannot acquire a writer or remove dirty contents, while the next writer succeeds.

Capture an empty legacy preview, physically remove the checkout, independently observe its real Git prunable record, replace the preview, then prune exactly that registration once. A repeated confirmation cannot reuse consumed consent; main HEAD, index, refs and payload stay unchanged.

Hold the parse worker, retire its ticket, then await the actual main result acknowledgement; no ownership scan starts and fixture deletion follows drainage.

An explicit unsupported protocol result launches once across repeated requests.

Compare exact final content when output has no final LF.

contracts.invariant: Completion preserves exit status and accepted bytes, while genuinely incomplete drainage stays explicit. Checked worktree writers retain their service, repository, task, canonical execution context and FIFO admission through terminal reconciliation. Closure and preference changes cancel queued work and reads while admitted writes and their operation-owned reconciliation finish; completion and admission release occur exactly once, including late callbacks and reconciliation failures. Native verification captures every output byte before independently mirroring it to the console; console backpressure cannot stall child completion or watchdogs, and capture failure remains a failing verification.
contracts.rootCause: Leader exit is mistaken for EOF; arbitrary reader cutoffs truncate finite streams or hide descendant output. Treating a presentation cancellation as writer cancellation can terminate Git mid-write; shared discovery cancellation can also erase a completed write's reconciliation and release the queue too early.

tests.oracle: Compare complete bytes from slow finite readers.
Observe descendant output released after the parent exits.
Repeated drainage cannot upgrade an incomplete stream to complete EOF.
A controlled peer exit between reads preserves its final acknowledgement.
The failure reason retains diagnostics written just before exit.
Injected application resource failures preserve caller descriptors and the successful control reaps its child.
Only a positive syscall write makes commit publication uncertain.
Actual Git writes are reconciled before completion and FIFO release, then a following real writer advances.

Closure and preference changes leave an admitted task running; captured-context reconciliation completes before the following actual writer.
Closure and preference changes do not cancel post-write reconciliation or release the queue before terminal completion.

A closed owner retains its post-write read and FIFO lease until completion, then rejects late publication and duplicate release.
Retain a terminal task callback after a document-owned operation completes; weak repository and service references must release.

Observe the actual held utility phase and independent main actor progress; reserve FIFO before capture, then await the service main-result acknowledgement before checking exact delivery and following real-writer progress or deleting fixtures.

Hold the actual evidence worker, cancel once, and prove early Cocoa completion, weak completion-owner release and following real-writer progress while still held; then await the actual main-result discard acknowledgement and require unchanged completion/preparation counts and Git state before teardown.
Use the default document-owned service and distinct executable proxies to prove both the admitted write and its reconciliation run the captured canonical Git after preferences change.
Cancel the report task through both Swift and Cocoa errors while its owner stays current; require Cocoa cancellation, exactly-once completion, unchanged metadata and subsequent FIFO progress.

Deliver both Swift and Cocoa cancellation errors from the operation-owned initial discovery while its owner stays live; require one Cocoa cancellation completion, no report or prune launch, exact Git metadata preservation, and one following real writer in FIFO order.
After explicit scope approval, hold the repair writer and verify a following unlock remains blocked through write and reconciliation.
Hold the final validation worker, replace or close its owner, acknowledge the late result once and prove the following request advances without any repair or filesystem changes.
Failed and truncated preflight reads never remove the checkout, preserve bytes, and release the next queued writer.
Cancel an owned removal read, deliver retained late callbacks, and prove exactly-once completion, no removal, and following-service progress.

contracts.invariant: Rendered and exported diagnostics redact credentials across every chunk/cutoff boundary while preserving ordinary URLs. Public worktree lifecycle diagnostics contain finite operation, phase and rejection categories plus counts; raw Git arguments, output, lock reasons, branch names and filesystem paths never enter those public events. Sensitive diagnostic details use existing redaction and private visibility while execution and authorization evidence stay raw. Each terminal lifecycle failure has one logging owner preserving its actual phase and finite category; removal consent rejection uses consent.
contracts.rootCause: Truncating before redaction or parsing only common userinfo shapes can expose secrets. Interpolating full lifecycle arguments or failed output publicly exposes user-authored lock reasons and repository details.

tests.oracle: Ordinary URLs and subsequent diagnostics remain byte-faithful.
Every two-part split excludes the credential from output.
Both summary cutoff and full export exclude secrets.
Malformed userinfo stays redacted through the application boundary.
Dotted usernames and numeric password prefixes remain hidden across chunks.

After real service routes, poll fresh current-process OSLog snapshots on one utility task with 0/250/500/1000ms backoff, a monotonic retry deadline and propagated query errors; require both exact positive events and reject every raw argument, output and lock-reason canary in the same successful snapshot.

contracts.invariant: An export error survives temporary invisibility and is discarded only after actual owner dismissal.
contracts.rootCause: Visibility is confused with lifetime, causing lost errors or presentation on a closed owner.

tests.oracle: Observe actual owned artifact, destination and restored control.
Hide/minimize then restore; exactly one error is presented.
Closed or detached owners receive no later error.

contracts.invariant: Tests and explicit-checkout Git inspection isolate inherited repository selectors while retaining configured local hooks and binary input. Presentation fixtures retain files through cancellation and main-actor worker acknowledgement, restore the original Git preference once, then remove only drained fixtures. Explicit presentation-fixture opens establish the existing host as active and its visible owner window or sheet as key before queue actions; later production resumption remains focus-preserving.
contracts.rootCause: Ambient repositories, config, hooks and identity make tests pass against the wrong state. Preference notifications during teardown can restart services, while premature fixture deletion races late workers.

tests.oracle: Inspect isolated Git environment and preserved non-Git variables.
Real Git commits preserve explicitly configured fixture hooks.
Compare exact binary stdin bytes.
Hold an actual discovery worker; cleanup must remain pending with its files present until the late worker result is acknowledged on main.
At the actual single preference-restoration boundary, both real fixture roots still exist and all services are drained; afterward the original preference is restored and both roots are absent.
Hide the test application, explicitly open a fixture, and require the same existing host to be active with a visible key owner before starting queue assertions.

contracts.invariant: Required Objective-C selectors and Swift consumers remain valid in both build configurations; Objective-C-imported subclasses can execute controller callbacks without Swift-only virtual dispatch failures. Legacy worktree service selectors and the programmatic showHistoryView: entry remain available alongside the separate returnToHistory: responder action in Debug and Release. Sendable capability callbacks read their exact imported task's flags only through a main-actor boundary, preserving weak retention and generation guards under fresh compiler analysis. Debug-only worktree fixture selectors and their Objective-C test declarations/consumers are excluded together from Release; production-facing service tests remain executable in Release. Read-only inventoryStatus is observable in both configurations and has no setter.
contracts.rootCause: Conditional runtime/test surfaces or bridge annotations compile in Debug but fail in Release; new Swift-only virtual state accessors can have missing dispatch slots in Objective-C-imported subclasses.

tests.oracle: Invoke the window delegate through an Objective-C-imported subclass and preserve both nil-window and loaded-window state without crashing or presenting a repair sheet.
Query required Objective-C selectors in the running Debug host.
Exercise the imported task and configuration-dependent runtime surface in Debug.
Exercise the imported task and configuration-dependent runtime surface in Release.

A nib-backed loadWindow probe stays at zero across owner setters and Objective-C-imported callbacks; explicit KVO delivers the real repository change through the existing layout barrier, and showWindow provides a positive load control.

Objective-C KVC metadata matches isolated real local/locked, detached, missing/prunable and bare Git records; HEAD/index/gitfile/backlink/content/ref bytes remain unchanged and no lifecycle writer runs.
Runtime queries preserve all existing worktree service selectors and distinguish programmatic History from explicit History in both test consumers.

Compile all three main-queue conveniences from a nonisolated helper whose inferred callbacks bind nonoptional MainActor = #isolation, so missing callback annotations cause ordinary type errors; execute real commands and require MainActor.shared identity, exact output, nil errors and exactly-once delivery. Arbitrary-queue PBTask lifecycle tests retain their requested-queue contract.
Query actual Objective-C instance methods in Debug: fixture hooks, drainage and repair harness selectors exist, while production compatibility selectors remain available.
Query actual Objective-C instance methods in Release: fixture hooks, drainage and repair harness selectors are absent, while production compatibility selectors remain available.

contracts.invariant: UI fixture repositories ignore untracked Finder metadata while preserving real untracked files, explicitly tracked metadata and existing exclusion rules.
contracts.rootCause: Finder-created .DS_Store files alter first-file selection, dirty counts and before/after status oracles.

tests.oracle: Real Git status still reports a modified tracked .DS_Store and ordinary untracked source.
Inject root and nested Finder metadata; real Git status retains only real files, including a similarly named notes file.
Preserve existing rule bytes and Git ignore/negation behavior; repeated setup keeps the same exclusion file.
Repeated policy setup preserves exclusion bytes even with a trailing unrelated rule or no final newline.
Linked worktree status ignores metadata using the resolved Git exclusion location.
A clone automatically receives metadata exclusion through the shared creation boundary.

contracts.invariant: An explicit revision selection survives load-start callbacks for old or empty content and applies to the first populated replacement snapshot, or a completed empty load. Passive refresh preserves browsing, pending intent does not retain previous history, and deep links retain their explicit target.
contracts.rootCause: A load-start KVO callback consumed forced selection against old rows; later publications then preserved the wrong commit.

tests.oracle: A passive load-start and replacement snapshot preserve the actual browsed commit before and after completion.
Deliver load-start KVO after a real requested revision while old rows remain; publish a replacement model and verify the requested real commit OID both while loading and after completion.
Old or empty replacement snapshots retain intent; the first populated replacement selects immediately, completed empty loads settle, and ordinary browsing cancels pending authority.
The old snapshot deallocates while selection is pending; a subsequent populated publication still progresses.

Dispatch the actual History responder for a refreshed linked checkout, verify latest commit rendering and later deep-link selection, and independently prove physical Git refs and HEADs remain unchanged.
